messages.subject: simdata factor.loads argument
parts:
Hi All,

In the documentation for the simdata function, it's noted that item slopes can be submitted as a matrix factor loadings if factor.loads=TRUE.  Is factor.loads an argument of the simdata function?  I get an error when I treat it as such.  How do I specify that a is a matrix of factor loadings?

Thanks to all,
Katherine

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: simdata factor.loads argument
parts:
Hi Katherine,

This looks to be legacy documentation because I removed this option a while back. Sorry for not fixing the help files accordingly. 

To use simdata you should convert your standardized loadings manually to slopes (see Wirth & Edwards 2007 for more details). Below is some example code. Cheers.


# convert factor loadings to slopes
F2a <- function(F, D=1.702){
    h2 <- rowSums(F^2)
    a <- (F / sqrt(1 - h2)) * D
    a
}

(F <- matrix(c(rep(.7, 5), rep(.5,5))))
(a <- lambda2a(F))
d <- rnorm(10)

dat <- simdata(a, d, 5000, itemtype = 'dich')
mod <- mirt(dat, 1)
coef(mod, simplify=TRUE)
summary(mod)


Phil
